session_spawn.title: Start an agent on a task
session_spawn.description: Start an agent on a task. Creates a session record for the run, an initial log entry naming the provider (agent runner), model and reasoning effort, and a claim reserving the task for that session; committing that starts the agent, so a task another session already holds refuses the whole request. With wait, returns how the run ended (its brief or final output, and its exit code when recorded) instead of the session id. Returns text in content.body. A wait timeout reports that the run is still running and does not kill it.

task.description: the task to hand to the agent, which the session claims; pass its id or registered name

provider.description: id or registered name of the provider (agent runner); it must use command-line transport

model.description: id or registered name of the model the run uses; optional

effort.description: the reasoning effort, where the model accepts such a setting

instruction.description: what to tell the agent (default: the task’s id and title; it holds the claim and reads the rest itself)

wait.description: block until the run is over and return how it ended

timeout.description: how long to wait: 45m, 2h, or bare seconds (default 30m)

session_wait.title: Wait for a session to end
session_wait.description: Wait for a session to end, then return its brief (or final output) and exit code when recorded, as text in content.body. A session still running when the timeout passes is reported as still running, never killed.

session.description: the session to wait on; pass its id or registered name

timeout.description: how long to wait: 45m, 2h, or bare seconds (default 30m)

session_peek.title: Read the end of a session
session_peek.description: Return the last entries of an agent work session as stored in the graph, one line per entry, plus its current status. Returns at most lines entries (40 by default), as text in content.body; never the provider’s own log file.

session.description: the session to read; pass its id or registered name

lines.description: how many entries to return, newest last (default 40)

spawn_start.description: start the run a session asks for: a `using` written on an entry names the provider, the model and the effort

spawn_stop.description: kill the run a `stop` on the session running it names
